eligibility_requires: successful two-action model-own prefix under existing exact action-validity guards
a shared deterministic immediate action a3
two distinct top step2 phase labels, with the second-highest normalized six-label probability >=0.10 and all six scores finite
both carrier byte strings serialize exactly52 ASCII bytes
future-only discounted carrier L1 distance D_future = gamma^2*L1(row3_A,row3_B) + gamma^3*L1(row4_A,row4_B) >=0.50; forced row2 branch identity contributes exactly zero to this gate
constructibility.interpretation: Constructibility only. PASS requires nontrivial model-predicted successor divergence beyond the forced row2 branch label; it is not causal support and does not authorize indices16..31 until a separately frozen/reviewed causal-development protocol exists.

cut.shared_immediate_action_a3: deterministic greedy admissible-command scorer at the frozen snapshot; identical for both carrier branches
cut.snapshot_contains: exact task instruction + exact observable action/observation history through cut2 + current observation + lexically sorted current admissible commands

definition.ACQUIRE_OBJECT: predicted action purpose is taking/picking up the task target object
definition.CARRY_OR_SEEK_RECEPTACLE: predicted action purpose is carrying/navigating toward the task target receptacle after acquisition
definition.MANIPULATE_CONTAINER: predicted action purpose is opening/closing or otherwise manipulating a visible container/receptacle as an enabling step
definition.OTHER: none of the preceding frozen procedural phases
definition.PLACE_OBJECT: predicted action purpose is placing/putting the task target object into/on the task target receptacle
definition.SEEK_OBJECT: predicted action purpose is navigation/search directed at the task target object before possession

feature_map.name: OBSERVABLE_PROCEDURAL_PHASE_V1
feature_map.task_entities_source: task instruction visible at the cut only; no expert trajectory, goal-state oracle, future observation, simulator lookahead, or ground-truth future action

future_causal_claim_guard: Any later causal pilot must hold exact reset snapshot and shared immediate a3 fixed across carrier arms, exclude first action from substantive endpoint, preserve competence, and compare donor-specific later procedural preference against all frozen controls including BRANCH_PHASE_ONLY. It must be separately preregistered and independently reviewed before indices16..31 are touched.
kill_conditions: any required carrier needs future environment observation/simulator/expert leakage
exact tokenizer/prompt binding cannot make the six-label scorer deterministic without protocol drift
second-highest branch probability is <0.10 or any six-label score is non-finite
future-only rows3-4 discounted L1 is <0.50 even if row2 labels differ
any attempt to replace failed paths or use locked indices to repair constructibility

requirements: Implementation must freeze exact rendered prompt bytes for a synthetic canary and exact tokenizer suffix IDs for all six labels before any constructibility model call.
Tokenizer/model revision must equal the already frozen Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B revision.
Suffix scoring remains arithmetic mean token logprob followed by float64 six-way softmax; no generation/retry/paraphrase is permitted.
Independent executable review must recompute the prompt/suffix binding before science.

leakage_guards: No environment clone or simulator step after the cut.
No actual A4/A5/B4/B5 action identity may enter the forecaster.
No confirmation/valid path or previously selected path.
Branch identity is a predicted procedural-phase condition, not an oracle future action.

branch_plausibility_guard.normalized_probability: float64 softmax of the same six frozen label-suffix mean-logprob scores used for branch selection
branch_plausibility_guard.reason: prevents a vanishing-probability runner-up from becoming an automatically constructible branch

predictive_procedure.carrier_matrix: 4x6 temporal phase-probability matrix. Row1 is shared-immediate-action one-hot; row2 is oriented branch-label one-hot; rows3-4 are model-predicted phase distributions.

constructibility_distance.counterexample_guard: If rows3 and 4 are identical across branches, D_future is exactly0 regardless of row2 and the path fails constructibility.
constructibility_distance.name: FUTURE_ONLY_DISCOUNTED_L1_V2
constructibility_distance.row2_exclusion_reason: row2 is forced to differ by branch construction and therefore cannot provide evidence of successor divergence

predictive_procedure.discount_use: Constructibility uses ONLY genuinely predictive rows3..4: D_future = gamma^2*L1(row3_A,row3_B) + gamma^3*L1(row4_A,row4_B). Row2 is an explicit branch condition and is excluded from this gate. Serialization still retains all four rows so temporal order and branch identity are preserved.
predictive_procedure.name: MODEL_OWN_BRANCH_CONDITIONAL_PHASE_OCCUPANCY_V1
predictive_procedure.probability_rule: Normalize exact frozen label-suffix mean-logprob scores with softmax in float64. Exact tokenizer suffix IDs and prompt bytes must be frozen and independently reviewed before any execution.
predictive_procedure.quantization: Each row is deterministically quantized to six uint8 integers summing255 by largest-remainder allocation with ties by frozen label order.
predictive_procedure.serialization: SF1: followed by the 24 uint8 values as exactly 48 lowercase hexadecimal characters; fixed total ASCII length 52 bytes before the later interface wrapper.
predictive_procedure.step1: Map the already frozen shared immediate action a3 to one procedural phase row; this row is identical between branches.
predictive_procedure.step2: Using only the frozen cut snapshot plus the text of shared a3, score the six phase labels as the model-own prediction for the action-purpose immediately after a3. Normalize all six finite scores by float64 softmax; select the top two distinct labels with deterministic phase-label-order tie-break. Eligibility additionally requires the second-highest normalized label probability >=0.10. Orient A/B by SHA256(game_path|SUCCESSOR_FEATURE_BRANCH_ORIENTATION_V1) low bit.
predictive_procedure.steps3_4: For each branch separately, append only the branch phase-label history (never an imagined observation or hidden environment state), score the same six labels, and recursively append the greedy phase label. No actual future environment transition is queried.

prospective_causal_controls_locked_for_f.BRANCH_PHASE_ONLY: same 52-byte carrier budget; preserve each arm's exact row1 shared-action phase and row2 branch phase, but replace rows3 and4 by fixed neutral uint8 row [43,43,43,42,42,42] (sum255). This isolates branch-label-only steering from multi-step successor occupancy.
prospective_causal_controls_locked_for_f.CURRENT_STATE_ONLY: same 52-byte carrier budget derived only from frozen observable current-state feature vector; no predicted future rows
prospective_causal_controls_locked_for_f.IMMEDIATE_ACTION_ONLY: same 52-byte budget preserving only shared a3 phase identity; future rows fixed neutral
prospective_causal_controls_locked_for_f.SERIALIZATION_MATCHED_NULL: 52-byte deterministic hash-derived uint8 rows with the same per-row sum255 and no source model-prediction content
prospective_causal_controls_locked_for_f.TIME_SHUFFLED_OCCUPANCY: keep row1 and row2 fixed in their original positions; swap only genuine future-prediction rows3 and4 as [row4,row3], preserving both future rows and their feature marginals while disrupting their temporal order without moving branch identity.
prospective_causal_controls_locked_for_f.UNRELATED_SAME_BUDGET: 52-byte carrier from deterministic next eligible donor path, no self donor

row1_action_phase_mapping_v2.ambiguity_rule: first matching rule in frozen precedence wins; no learned classifier and no future state may resolve ambiguity
row1_action_phase_mapping_v2.inputs_only: task instruction, exact observable cut history/current observation, and exact shared a3; no post-cut information
row1_action_phase_mapping_v2.normalization: Unicode-preserving lowercase + strip for matching only; original shared a3 bytes remain separately frozen
precedence: If command verb is open or close => MANIPULATE_CONTAINER.
Else if command verb is take/pickup and command object matches visible task target object => ACQUIRE_OBJECT.
Else if command verb is put/place and command object/receptacle matches visible task entities => PLACE_OBJECT.
Else if command is navigation/search toward visible task target object before observable possession => SEEK_OBJECT.
Else if command is navigation/search toward visible task receptacle after observable possession => CARRY_OR_SEEK_RECEPTACLE.

scientific_difference: External structured predictive future-occupancy carrier; no hidden activation residual, literal plan text, transcript summary, present-state memory, or single-next-action carrier.
